# sigma_datasets (Data Source)

Lists Sigma datasets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_datasets" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `datasets` (Attributes List) Datasets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datasets))
- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--datasets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datasets`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator member ID.
- `description` (String) Dataset description.
- `id` (String) Dataset ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the dataset is archived.
- `name` (String) Dataset name.
- `owner` (String) Owner identifier.
- `path` (String) Dataset path.
- `updated_at` (String) Update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater member ID.
- `url` (String) Dataset URL.
